Name: Dynamic Map Tiles Extended - DMTE
Author: sexynes
Description:
Dynamic Map Tiles (DMT) lets you apply actions to map tiles that can be triggered in various ways.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/dJP8H2Z8/triggers.png[/img] 
﻿
DMT currently recognizes the following triggers: 

[list]
[*][b]Action [/b]- Triggers when the player acts on a tile. [/*]
[*][b]CropHarvest [/b]- Triggers when a crop, flower, or forage-crop has been harvested. [/*]
[*][b]CropPlanted [/b]- Triggers when a crop, flower, or forage-crop has been planted. [/*]
[*][b]Enter [/b]- Triggers when the player enters a location.[/*]
[*][b]Explode [/b]- Triggers when the tile is within the blast radius of an explosion. [/*]
[*][b]Item [/b]- Triggers when the player is holding a specified item when they interact with the tile.[/*]
[*][b]Load [/b]- Triggers when the map is first loaded.[/*]
[*][b]MonsterSlain [/b]- Triggers when the player slays a monster. [/*]
[*][b]ObjectClicked [/b]- Triggers when a specified item has finished producing an item, and the produced item is collected.﻿ [/*]
[*][b]ObjectPlaced [/b]- Triggers when a specified item is placed. [/*]
[*][b]ObjectRemoved [/b]- Triggers when a specified item that can be removed using a tool is removed.[/*]
[*][b]Off [/b]- Triggers when the player steps off a tile.[/*]
[*][b]On [/b]- Triggers when the player steps on a tile.[/*]
[*][b]Push [/b]- Triggers when a tile is pushed.[/*]
[*][b]Pushed [/b]- Triggers when a tile is done being pushed.[/*]
[*][b]Talk [/b]- Triggers when the player talks to an NPC.[/*]
[*][b]Tool [/b]- Triggers when a certain tool is used on a tile[/*]
[/list]Full documentation of triggers is available on [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/wiki/Dynamic-Map-Tiles-Extended-Triggers]GitHub[/url].

[img]https://i.ibb.co/GfVPfPLp/getting-started.png[/img] 

To get started with DMTE, begin by installing the mod. Once installed, create a folder where you can easily access it, and give it the name of your mod. 

Open the folder and create the following files:
manifest.json - The mod manifest required for any Stardew Valley mod (details can be found [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Manifest]here[/url]﻿)
content.json - The entry point for a Content Patcher mod (details can be found [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/develop/ContentPatcher/docs/author-guide.md#get-started]here[/url]﻿) 

The Content Patcher documentation explains in great detail how the syntax should be filled out, so it is recommended that the documentation is thoroughly read. The mod does not need to be added as a dependency, and any edit can be added conditionally with Content Patcher's HasMod condition.﻿ 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/XrkQsQCW/how-to-add-tile-actions.png[/img] 

Tile actions can be added to the map in two ways: EditMap and EditData. 

[size=4][b]
EditMap[/b] [/size]

Any tile action keys can be added directly to a tile's properties by editing the map tiles, like so:

{
    "Format": "2.8.0",
    "Changes": 
    [
        {
           "LogName": "Change A Tile Index When Stepped On A Specific Coordinate",
           "Action": "EditMap",
            "Target": "Maps/Farm",
            "MapTiles": 
            [
                {
                    "Position": 
                    { 
                        "X": 72, 
                        "Y": 15 
                    },
                    "Layer": "Back",
                    "SetProperties": 
                    {
                        "DMT/changeIndex_On": "69"
                    }
                }
            ]
        }
    ]
}

The above code edits the farm map, and sets the property "DMT/changeIndex" on the tile at position X:72,Y:15 on the "Back" layer. This property has the trigger "On", meaning the property will activate when the player steps on the tile. Once activated, the tile's texture will change the specified index in it's tilesheet (in this case: "69").

You can add Once or Swap in-between the action and the trigger, e.g.:

"DMT/changeIndex_Once_On"
"DMT/changeIndex_Swap_On"

Once will remove the property after being triggered once.
Swap will swap the property with a property with the same key prefixed by "Swap", e.g.:

"DMT/changeIndex_Swap_On",
"SwapDMT/changeIndex_Swap_On"

You need to create both entries for Swap to work.


[size=4][b]EditData[/b] [/size]

The mod also provides a custom data dictionary which you can add all your stuff to, which will automatically be applied to game locations when loaded. The data contains the following fields:

Locations: (optional) A list of names of the locations to apply the properties to, for example: "Locations: ["Farm", "Beach"]" or "locations: ["Town", "Mountain", "Forest"]". Leaving this out or empty will apply the action to every location (not recommended).

Layers: (optional) A list of IDs of layers to apply the properties to, for example: "Layers: ["Back"]" or "layers: ["Buildings"]". Leaving this out or empty will apply to every layer (not recommended).

TileSheets: (optional) A list of IDs of tilesheets to check against before applying any properties. If a tile does not have the specified tilesheet ID, the property will not be applied. For example: "TileSheets: ["indoors"]" or "tileSheets: ["outdoors"]".

TileSheetPaths: (optional) A list of IDs of tilesheet paths to check against before applying any properties. If a tile does not have a tilesheet with the specified path, the property will not be applied.

Indexes: (optional) A list of numerical IDs of tile indexes to check against before applying any properties. If a tile's index in the tilesheet does not appear in this list, the property will not be applied.

Rectangles: (optional) A list of specified areas to search within, for example: "Rectangles: [{"X": 5, "Y": 7, "Width": 3, "Height": 3}, {"X": 12, "Y": 23, "Width": 2, "Height": 6}]"". Rectangles are searched on a tile basis, instead of a size basis.

Tiles: (optional) A list of specified tiles on which to apply the actions, for example: "Tiles: [{"X": 7, "Y": 18}, {"X": 24, "Y": 20}]". Recommended use alongside Layers. 

Properties: (optional) A dictionary of properties to apply when the conditions are met. This field is the old format; use Actions instead.

Actions: A list of objects which specify details for properties to apply to a map. Actions have the following format:

[list]
[*]LogName: (optional) A unique name which will be included whenever anything related to this property is logged to the console, useful for debugging.[/*]
[*]Key: The key of the tile property, like "DMT/give" or "DMT/animate". [/*]
[*]Value: The value of the tile property following the format described by the action you want to use.[/*]
[*]Trigger: (dependent on action) The trigger to use for activating this property.[/*]
[*]Once: (optional) Whether to only run this property once and then remove it. Default false.[/*]
[*]Swap: (optional) Swap this key's value with the value of the same key prefixed by [b]Swap[/b] after triggering (e.g. [b]DMT/sound [/b]and [b]SwapDMT/sound[/b]). Default false.[/*]
[/list]
Following the updated format, your Content Patcher file should look something like this:

{
  "Format": "2.8.0",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "LogName": "Slippery Tiles",
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "DMT/Tiles",
      "Entries": {
        "{{ModId}}.IceTiles": {
          "Locations": [
            "Forest"
          ],
          "Layers": [
            "Back"
          ],
          "TileSheets": [
            "fest"
          ],
          "TileSheetPaths": [
            "Festivals"
          ],
          "Indexes": [
            226,
            227
          ],
          "Rectangles": [
            {
              "X": 0,
              "Y": 0,
              "Width": 100,
              "Height": 100
            }
          ],
          "Actions": [
            {
              "LogName": "Ice Tiles Festival",
              "Key": "DMT/slippery",
              "Value": "0.25",
              "Trigger": "Load",
              "Once": false
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}

This is an updated version of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14566]Dynamic Map Tiles[/url] mod by aedenthorn, rewritten from scratch by MindMeldMax for easier extensibility. This mod replaces and extends the DMT framework that lets modders create dynamic game mechanics by assigning tile properties to individual or broad map tiles. While most former DMT content packs will not directly work without edits, these changes should be minor; however, it is advised to migrate to the updated syntax. 

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
